[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Introduction to Prettier: JavaScript Code Formatting"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Prettier is an opinionated code formatter that supports JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, CSS, HTML, JSON, and more. It enforces a consistent style by parsing your code and re-printing it with its own rules, taking maximum line length into account. Prettier eliminates all original styling and ensures that all outputted code conforms to a consistent style."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Why Use Prettier?"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Enforces consistent code style across your entire project."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Reduces code review time by eliminating style-related discussions."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Automates code formatting, saving developers time and effort."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Supports a wide range of languages and frameworks."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Installation"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can install Prettier globally or locally within your project. We recommend installing it locally as a dev dependency."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"npm install --save-dev prettier"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Or, using Yarn:"},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"yarn add --dev prettier"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Configuration"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"Prettier can be configured using a '.prettierrc.json', '.prettierrc.yaml', '.prettierrc.yml', '.prettierrc.js', 'prettier.config.js', or directly in your 'package.json' file. Here's an example '.prettierrc.json' file:"},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"{ 
  "semi": true,
  "trailingComma": "es5",
  "singleQuote": true,
  "printWidth": 80,
  "tabWidth": 2
}"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"Here's a breakdown of the options used in the example:"},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":""semi": true - Adds semicolons at the end of statements."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":""trailingComma": "es5" - Adds trailing commas wherever valid in ES5 (objects, arrays, etc.)."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":""singleQuote": true - Uses single quotes instead of double quotes."},{"order":20,"type":"bullet_point","text":""printWidth": 80 - Specifies the line length that the printer will wrap on."},{"order":21,"type":"bullet_point","text":""tabWidth": 2 - Specifies the number of spaces per indentation-level."},{"order":22,"type":"subheading","text":"Running Prettier"},{"order":23,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can run Prettier from the command line to format files. For example, to format all JavaScript files in your project, you can use the following command:"},{"order":24,"type":"code","text":"npx prettier --write ./**/*.js"},{"order":25,"type":"paragraph","text":"This command uses 'npx' to run the locally installed Prettier package. The '--write' flag tells Prettier to overwrite the files with the formatted code. The pattern './**/*.js' specifies all JavaScript files in the current directory and its subdirectories."},{"order":26,"type":"subheading","text":"Integrating with VS Code"},{"order":27,"type":"paragraph","text":"To integrate Prettier with VS Code, install the 'Prettier - Code formatter' extension. After installing the extension, you can configure VS Code to format your code on save. Open your VS Code settings (File > Preferences > Settings) and search for 'format on save'. Check the 'Editor: Format On Save' box."},{"order":28,"type":"paragraph","text":"You may also need to set Prettier as the default formatter. In your VS Code settings, search for 'default formatter' and select 'Prettier - Code formatter' from the dropdown."},{"order":29,"type":"subheading","text":"Ignoring Files"},{"order":30,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can tell Prettier to ignore certain files and directories by creating a '.prettierignore' file in the root of your project. This file works similarly to '.gitignore'. Here's an example '.prettierignore' file:"},{"order":31,"type":"code","text":"node_modules/
dist/
*.lock"},{"order":32,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":33,"type":"paragraph","text":"Prettier is a valuable tool for maintaining consistent code style in JavaScript projects. By automating code formatting, it saves developers time and effort, reduces code review time, and improves code readability. Integrating Prettier into your workflow can significantly enhance your development process."}]
